title: Automated compliance remediation tasks
description: Triggers Azure Policy remediation tasks for resources that are non-compliant with 'DeployIfNotExists' or 'Modify' policies.
example_prompt: "List all non-compliant resources under policies with effect 'DeployIfNotExists' or 'Modify' that have a remediation task available. For each policy: (1) count of remediable resources, (2) create a remediation task if none exists or last task is > 7 days old, (3) check status of in-progress remediation tasks. Report: tasks created, in-progress, and completed."
